grid_master.note: No dummy grids or drawing-break lines observed on any sheet checked so far - all bay footings/columns/beams sit on named grid intersections. Stage 1 must still re-verify this per the README's mandatory drawing-break-line check before finalizing the grid master.

buildings_detected.note: Single detached house, single grid system (1-4 / A-F) repeated identically across every plan sheet checked (architectural, structural, sanitary, electrical, mechanical). No secondary/detached structure (e.g. separate toilet block) appears in the TOC or on any page opened. §11a multi-building handling not needed for this house.

flags: Interpretive decision: pattern:plan was assigned to MEP plan sheets (SN-04, SN-05, EE-03, EE-04, M-01) because they literally meet the schema's plan definition ('floor plan/layout, has grid_ref'), even though they are not structural and do not participate in the grid-geometry conflict-precedence chain (only S-sheets win grid disputes). This expands the Stage-1 plan workload beyond the architectural+structural set implied by the README's house-07 example table. Made per the op2 standing order (decide, don't ask) - Stage 1 should treat these 5 as lower-priority/no-span-calc plan files (position-callout joins only, no beam span math) rather than re-classifying them.

SN-05 and EE-04 were not individually opened during Stage 0 (only their sister sheets SN-04/EE-03 were read) - their pattern/grid assignment is inferred from being the paired ชั้นล่าง sheet in the same 2-sheet sub-group per the TOC. Stage 1/2 must confirm on actual read.

BOQ page count for both groups (spread-footing PNG52-61, pile-footing PNG62-71) is derived purely from the TOC's doc-page ranges via the offset formula, not from opening any BOQ page directly. Sheet names/sheet_no per page unknown until Stage 2 opens them.

The regulatory section (หลักเกณฑ์และข้อกำหนด..., doc page 70 onward) has no printed end page in the TOC. PNG72-74 (3 pages) is inferred only by subtracting the confirmed back-cover page (PNG75) from the total page count (75) - genuinely not verifiable further without opening those pages, which Stage 0 explicitly should not do (out of automation scope, manual-extraction pattern 'notes'). Flagging per the standing order's rule against guessing silently.

A-05 (แปลนหลังคา, PNG07) was deliberately classified as pattern:roof_plan, not plan, because it shows ridge/slope/eave geometry (SLOPE 6, roof outline dashed beyond the wall grid) matching schema pattern #12's stated reason for splitting roof_plan out of plan. S-06 (แปลนโครงหลังคา, structural purlin/rafter layout) was kept as plain plan since it carries no ridge/hip/eave lines, only member marks on the grid, same shape as S-04.

No drawing break lines or dummy grid lines were observed on any of the 8 plan-type sheets opened during Stage 0 (S-02 through S-06, A-04, SN-04, EE-03, M-01) - all footings/columns/beams land on named grid intersections (1-4 / A-F). This is a preliminary read only; Stage 1 must still perform the mandatory beam-endpoint check across every plan file before finalizing the grid master, per the README's house-06 lesson.
